name: dotted-trail
title: Dotted Trail
description: Interactive dotted grid with a soft two-color cursor trail

changelog.summary: Initial release: WebGL dotted grid with an SDF cursor trail, radial two-color blend, and remixer controls.

props.name: colorB
props.description: Outer color the blend runs toward.

props.name: headRadius
props.description: Radius of the blob at the cursor.

props.name: glowRadius
props.description: Reach of the soft glow around the cursor.

props.name: followSpeed
props.description: How quickly the trail chases the cursor.

props.name: trailLength
props.description: How many nodes the tail trails behind.

props.name: fadeOnIdle
props.description: Fade the cursor out when it rests.

props.name: idleDelay
props.description: Stillness before the fade starts, ms.

props.name: idleFade
props.description: How long the fade takes, ms.

props.name: rimInner
props.description: Where the blend starts, inside the shape.

props.name: rimOuter
props.description: Where the blend finishes, past the edge.

props.name: edgeDesaturate
props.description: Pulls the fading edge back toward colorA.

props.name: edgeDesaturateSpan
props.description: Band width that desaturation acts over.

props.name: tailTilt
props.description: Extra drift toward colorB along the tail.

props.name: dotSpacing
props.description: Distance between dots in the grid.
